# Closed generic superclass call with a boolean result

An owned child closes two parent formals to String and Object and passes a
private normalization result with two original value references to invoke-super.
Four frozen caller routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK parents,
including an owned future override that rejects virtual redispatch. Callbacks
choose both boolean results independently of the inputs. Normalization aliases,
nulls, argument identities, partial writes, stage failures and exact checked,
runtime and error failures remain observable. Every recovered unit and original
metadata entry, including a methodless marker, is compiled and audited. Six wrong
programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof. Only owned
classes execute.
